title: Toronto to Niagara Falls Tour: Skip-the-Line Boat & Journey
includes: Skip the line Journey Behind the Falls admission ( optional)
Skip the line Hornblower Niagara Cruise (seasonal)
Round trip transportation from downtown Toronto
Maple & Chocolate factory visit with tasting samples
Sightseeing stops at the Floral Clock, Whirlpool Rapids, & Hydroelectric Power Plant
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Operates 364 Days in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
Hornblower Boat Cruise operating Schedule is from May to December each Year
Storage Rack's available for your shopping bags on the bus
We provide a souvenir rain poncho for the boat, but we recommend first-time visitors wear waterproof shoes. Avoid leather or suede as the mist is quite heavy!
We’ve timed this tour so you see the Falls from three distinct perspectives: ground level, behind the sheet of water, and 775 feet above at the Skylon Tower.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Leave the hustle of Toronto behind and experience one of Canada’s most iconic destinations on this full-day, Tour to Niagara Falls. Travel in a comfortable minibus with a friendly, knowledgeable guide and enjoy key attractions such as the Hornblower Niagara Cruise, Journey Behind the Falls, and the Skylon Tower. Visit a local maple syrup factory and a chocolate factory, where you'll enjoy complimentary tastings. With a small group size, you'll get a more personalized and relaxed experience from start to finish.
